title: H5a: executor running counters derived from bus state at Pool load (no persisted increments, legacy codex mirror dropped); codex and codex_reply MCP tools post their result to the bus
spec:
Build on goal/T-0353. Evidence (gotchas 2026-09-19 23:24 and 23:38): pool_state.json persists executors[*].running and codex.running, incremented in executor.py:83-84 and decremented only in the normal finally path (executor.py:94-95), so every process killed by a session restart leaks a slot; pool._sync_legacy_codex mirrors codex.running onto the legacy executor (astra), and daemon.free_slots then reports zero slots (two ready tasks sat queued five minutes on 2026-09-19). Separately, mcp.py codex and codex_reply return the Codex result dict without posting it, so the task stays running until the Planner posts by hand (T-0326, T-0331, T-0273, T-0277, T-0348).
1. Pool load computes each executor's running count from bus tasks: status running, role execute, and executor == that id (fall back to tier == id for rows without executor). Remove the persisted running increments and decrements from executor.py and the running key from EXEC_STATE_FIELDS; keep cooldown and day_tasks persisted. Drop the running mirror in _sync_legacy_codex (keep the cooldown and day_tasks bridging). status() and free_slots keep their shapes.
2. mcp.codex and mcp.codex_reply: when the tool returns a result for a task whose status is running and assigned_to is codex, post it with bus.post_result(task_id, {summary from the final message, commit sha parsed from the message when present else the worktree HEAD, executed_by codex:<executor>, provenance [repo], usage}, "done") exactly as executor._dispatch_worker's normal path does (reuse that function; do not duplicate the mapping). A result that already exists is not overwritten. The tool reply says posted: true or false and why.
Tests: tests/test_pool.py::test_running_counts_come_from_bus_not_state_file (state file says 7 running, bus has one running task -> 1), ::test_restart_killed_process_leaks_no_slot; tests/test_mcp.py::test_codex_tool_posts_result_for_running_codex_task, ::test_codex_reply_does_not_overwrite_existing_result. Keep every existing test green (adjust tests that asserted persisted running); .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: grep shows no 'running +=' or 'running -=' in orchestrator/executor.py and 'running' is absent from EXEC_STATE_FIELDS
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

- MCP Codex tools post completed results once, including commit, executor, provenance, and usage.
- Added requested pool and MCP regressions; all 52 scoped/executor tests pass.
